capabilities: insert editable count blocks via the Count Block: Insert command or by wrapping selected text
count text with words, characters, UTF-8 bytes, or NEIS bytes metrics
enforce minimum and maximum limits with red footer warnings on violations
set metrics and bounds globally or per block with inline options
extras: Nested count blocks inside lists or blockquotes are not yet supported by the live editor footer; custom metrics and i18n are on the roadmap.
motivation: The author built it mainly because Korean schools use the NEIS byte-counting method, which standard byte counting does not match.
problem: Obsidian's word count covers the whole note, so writers cannot track counts for a specific passage against required limits.
summary: Text-counting plugin that renders editable code blocks with a live counter footer showing words, characters, or byte-based metrics.
